zh-CN: 统一桌面导入、项目自动接纳、Inbox、Agent/CLI 与系统剪贴板的图片输入协议
自动接纳与 Agent/CLI 新增 AVIF、GIF、BMP、ICO 和 JFIF 支持
补齐新格式的容器头、尺寸限制与隔离解码校验，同时保持上游 Excalidraw 不变
en: Unify image input across desktop import, project intake, Inbox, Agent/CLI, and the system clipboard
Add AVIF, GIF, BMP, ICO, and JFIF support to automatic intake and Agent/CLI writes
Validate container headers, dimensions, and isolated decoding for the new formats while leaving upstream Excalidraw unchanged
